I am an old man farming here near Dar es Salaam. I have no schooling, but I know this land. On this plot of about 1.35 hectares I grow mixed crops together — cassava with some vegetables and a little maize between them, because that way if one fails the other feeds us. I cannot afford to buy chemical fertilizer this year, the price is too high, so I will put the manure from my goats and some compost from the household waste. I use the seeds I kept from last harvest, and my wife and grown children help me with the hoe. Sometimes when weeding is heavy I pay a neighbour for a few days.
